title: Minimum Contents Deductible on a Proof of Loss — NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
Deductible rule for contents proofs of loss on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own).

**Minimum.** For the contents deductible a contents proof of loss subtracts, and only for that deductible, the minimum follows the building limit the way the federal minimum deductibles pair the building and contents minimums: the higher minimum building deductible when the building limit is above the deductible threshold, and the tier's minimum contents deductible otherwise; every other minimum contents deductible remains the tier's minimum contents deductible.

**Rule.** The contents deductible a contents proof of loss subtracts is settled as follows: when the building limit is above the deductible threshold, the contents deductible shown on the policy is below the higher minimum building deductible and the premium account shows a renewal risk premium charge, it is that higher minimum; when the building limit is at or below the deductible threshold, the contents deductible shown on the policy is below the tier's minimum contents deductible and the premium account shows a renewal risk premium charge, it is that minimum contents deductible; otherwise it is the contents deductible shown on the policy.

Figures on every tier: deductible threshold — a building limit of 100000; higher minimum building deductible — 1250; minimum contents deductible — 1000.

## Condition table

| Building limit | Contents deductible shown | Renewal risk premium charge on the account | Contents deductible subtracted |
|---|---|---|---|
| above 100000 | below 1250 | yes | 1250 |
| above 100000 | below 1250 | no | as shown |
| above 100000 | 1250 or more | either | as shown |
| 100000 or less | below 1000 | yes | 1000 |
| 100000 or less | below 1000 | no | as shown |
| 100000 or less | 1000 or more | either | as shown |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, each renewed)

- Building limit 160,000; contents deductible shown 1,000: 1250 is subtracted, because the building limit is above the threshold.
- Building limit 100,000; contents deductible shown 1,000: at the threshold, the minimum is 1000, so 1,000 as shown is subtracted.
